name: Color Field from image
description: Automatically fills a color_field with the dominant color of an image field on the same entity.
project_description:
Automatically fill a color_field field with the dominant image field from the same entity.

 For a full description of the module, visit the project page .

 Submit bug reports and feature suggestions, or track changes in the issue queue .

Requirements 
 The color_field module needs to be installed.

 Back to top 

 
Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 
Configuration 
 Add a color_field type field to any entity which already have an image field.

 During field configuration enable the "Color_field from image" behavior and select the relevant image field.

 Next time an entity is saved the color_field will be updated with the dominant color from the image file.
